references.text: Moses warns the people that they will quickly perish if they do not keep God's commands; same warning about destruction
Warning that Israel will perish like other nations if they forget the Lord and follow other gods
Describes how the people will be driven out of the land they are to possess as punishment for disobedience
Same warning that they will soon die in the good land the Lord gives them
Joshua repeats the warning that the Lord will drive them out of the good land if they turn away
The context setting up the choice between life and death, blessing and curse
Prophetic warning that the people will perish among the nations and the enemy's land will consume them
Call to keep the commands in order to live and enter the land, opposite of the warning in 30:18
